documents.content:
Prashant Sharma
ƒ +91 9027555614 # prashanttonusharma@gmail.com
ï linkedin.com/in/prashant-sharma § github.com/prashantsharma9027 € abc.in
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Full-Stack Engineer with 1.8 years of experience, delivering production-grade SaaS products actively used by 5,000+ users.
Proficient in Next.js, TypeScript, and FastAPI, with hands-on experience architecting RAG pipelines and LLM-powered systems.
Delivered applications with 95+ Lighthouse scores and 300+ SEO-indexed pages, taking end-to-end ownership of full-stack features
in agile engineering teams.
TECHNICAL SKILLS
Languages: JavaScript, TypeScript, Python
Frontend: Next.js, React.js, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, Recharts, TanStack Query, Zustand, Redux
Backend & APIs: FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, Django, Node.js, Express.js, GraphQL, WebSockets, REST APIs
Databases & DevOps: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, Docker, AWS (EC2, S3), Azure, Vercel, CI/CD, Git
AI & LLM Systems: RAG Pipelines, LLM Agents, pgvector, OpenAI Embeddings, OpenAI API, Gemini API, Prompt Engineering
EXPERIENCE
Full Stack Developer Jan 2025 – Mar 2026
FRIDAYY AI Gurugram, India (Remote)
• Led the frontend architecture for a Next.js SaaS platform, enabling 100+ vendors to launch Razorpay enabled, SEO-optimized
storefronts within minutes.
• Engineered a multi-tenant system with NextAuth OAuth2 flows, programmatic subdomain routing, and custom domain linking,
delivering 290+ indexed pages via server-side rendering.
• Implemented TanStack Query for caching and state management, reducing redundant API calls by 60% and achieving 95+
Lighthouse scores.
• Developed a RAG-powered Telegram bot supporting 7+ languages, integrating voice-to-command input and self-executing tool
calling for real-time CRUD operations.
Frontend Developer Jul 2024 – Nov 2024
SHEEGHRAM AI Remote
• Pioneered an AI hiring platform using Next.js to automate shortlisting for 200+ candidates per job post through CV parsing and
role-based matching.
• Architected a real-time voice interview module to orchestrate speech recognition and ElevenLabs, achieving sub-500ms response
latency for live interactions.
• Integrated Daily and Twilio to manage 5 simultaneous live sessions, reducing human interviewer overhead by 30% through
parallel processing.
• Built automated transcript analysis and rescheduling sequences to evaluate candidate performance, ensuring 100% candidate
reach during high-volume screening cycles.
PROJECTS
HIMEERA | Server-Sent Events, Cashfree, Progressive Web App, Noise Suppression SDK himeera.com
• Engineered a Conscious Intelligence (CI) companion with a streaming-optimized UI for real-time dialogue, multimodal code
generation, and image synthesis, achieving sub-0.4s response latency.
• Integrated Gemini Live API and a noise suppression SDK for voice interaction across 7+ languages, implementing persistent
context memory that improved response relevance by 40%.
• Implemented multimodal document input supporting PDF and DOCX uploads, with backend parsing to extract and inject content
into the LLM context for document-aware responses.
Podcast CMS & Analytics Platform | Cloudinary, TinyMCE, Mixpanel, MUI Charts cuhrious.show
• Architected a podcast CMS with JWT-secured APIs and RBAC, managing 100% of admin workflows and reducing content
publishing time by 40% via TinyMCE integration.
• Incorporated Mixpanel to monitor user interactions and built data-heavy tables with server-side sorting, filtering, pagination, and
CSV export to visualize retention patterns, reducing analysis time by 50% for 10,000+ rows of engagement data.
CERTIFICATIONS
• Generative AI Mastermind | Outskill: Diffusion Models, LLM Orchestration, and RAG.
• Full-Stack MERN Development: 4.5-month intensive program on full-stack application architecture.
• LeetCode Global Ranking: Top 1.85% (Ranked 92,046 of 5M+) | 500+ Day Streak Badge.
EDUCATION
Chandigarh University Aug 2020 – May 2024
Bachelor of Engineering in Computer Science and Engineering Mohali, Punjab

documents.content:
Friday AI Private Limited
26 Arya Nagar, Scheme No. 1, Vijay Mandir Road, Alwar, 301001, India
www.fridayy.ai
Date: April 10, 2026
RELIEVING LETTER
To Whomsoever It May Concern,
This is to certify that Mr. Prashant Sharma was employed with Friday AI Private Limited in the
capacity of Full Stack Developer from January 2025 to March 2026.
During his tenure, Prashant demonstrated exceptional technical depth and a consistent solution-
first approach to every challenge he encountered. He was a reliable and proactive team member
— someone the organization could count on to deliver, regardless of the complexity of the task at
hand.
His technical contributions to Fridayy’s product development were meaningful and impactful. He
brought not only strong engineering skills but also a genuine ownership mindset — consistently
going beyond the brief, contributing ideas, and helping the team move faster.
We confirm that Mr. Prashant Sharma has been relieved of his duties effective March 03, 2026,
and that there are no dues or obligations pending against him. He leaves with our best wishes
and our highest recommendation.
We wish Prashant every success in his future endeavours and are confident he will be a great
asset to any team he joins.
For Fridayy AI Private Limited
Ankit Agarwal
Founder & Director
Friday AI Private Limited
